categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet state management and storage files under src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Separating spent TXOs dramatically speeds up balance calculations and coin selection for active wallets with deep transaction histories. Reviewers observed massive speedups (remyers reported 250x and w0xlt reported ~508x on large synthetic test wallets), eliminating a major recurring performance bottleneck introduced when full TXO tracking was added.
